remarks:
Lake Erie shoreline like this, rarely comes up for sale.

The backyard was built for entertaining, anchored by a fire pit under mature shade trees and a full patio that opens straight onto owned waterfront. Add a staircase and this becomes your own private beach, just steps from the yard.

Inside, character meets comfort at every turn. The living room centers around a brick fireplace with custom built in shelving, while a second, more relaxed sitting room offers extra space to unwind. For real cooking, the kitchen brings generous counter space, and casual bar seating for entertaining while you cook. Just off the bright, sunlit dining room, sliding glass doors lead straight out to the patio, blending indoor and outdoor living with ease. Everyday convenience comes from a dedicated laundry room with a full bath, while an unfinished bonus room stands ready for whoever wants to build it out and make it their own.

At the water's edge, a separate outbuilding waits for its next chapter, whether that means a private cabana, a studio, or a personal retreat just steps from the shoreline, and an attached garage rounds out the property's practical side.

Zoned NC in the Town of Hamburg, this property offers flexibility rarely found on waterfront real estate. Live here as a full time residence, or take advantage of the zoning to run a storefront or home based business right on site. It currently operates as a short term rental, but would also make an excellent full time residence or a personal lake retreat. Hamburg's local shops, restaurants, and beaches sit just minutes away.
Showings begin Tuesday, August 25th, 2026.
This property is also listed commercially at the same price, under MLS#B1708473.
